decisions.reason: As a recent but technically adjacent niche extension, the glass flake spraying system still has option value and likely low incremental carrying cost, so with only limited market learning so far the firm would keep it.

The low-pressure injection pump is very close to the firm's core equipment range and has been given a dedicated market presence, so a medium-sized German machinery firm would likely continue it while demand evidence accumulates.

Because the low-pressure material transfer pump is a product line with several models built on existing capabilities, its strategic fit and reuse of established components make abandonment within a year unlikely.

Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm's move toward more digitalized customer solutions, and despite some uncertainty about uptake, the option to learn from the market is worth preserving for now.
